title.narrative: 2024-2025 Cash IM support Ukraine and neighboring countries - 510

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to support the Movement on CEA IM with a main focus on its implementation in CVA programs and CVA IM, for the Ukraine and impacted countries crisis. This project is an extension of the Project Cooperation Agreement with IFRC (continuation form 2023) from 2024 to beyond.
